cuts.reason: Punches in from the wide bedroom establishing shot to a tight close-up on Paul's exasperated face right as he lands the incredulous word 'possible?', isolating his reaction for comedic emphasis.
Cuts back out to the two-shot exactly on the wife's flat 'Paul.', so both her scolding delivery and his sheepish body language read together.
A very short (0.5s) same-angle reframe cut on 'It's', quickening the rhythm right before Paul's excuse/punchline to build anticipation.
Cuts on 'Not', holding the wide two-shot as Paul stumbles into his justification, letting the line land without moving away from the scene.
Hard cut from the live-action punchline beat straight to the black title/outro card, ending the sketch immediately after the joke lands.

reaction_shots.description: Tight close-up on Paul's face, eyebrows raised and mouth agape, reacting with disbelief while delivering '...possible?'

pacing_notes: Opens on a longer ~5s wide establishing shot to set up the clothes-shopping mess, then tightens sharply into a ~1.8s reaction close-up, a ~1.7s two-shot, and a very quick ~0.5s jump cut right before the punchline word, compressing rhythm as the argument peaks. It then holds slightly longer (~2.7s) on the wide two-shot for Paul's excuse to land, before a brief ~1.2s cut to the black outro card closes the episode.
